C_sun_kael.name: Kael Mack
C_sun_kael.role: itinerant drifter repeatedly assigned identities and histories by other people; the title invites a fugitive reading he does not validate
C_sun_kael.voice: low, spare, practical; refuses grand explanations without sounding evasive
C_sun_kael.visual: lean athletic man, sharp angular face, dark stubble, shoulder-length raven-black hair, deeply sun-weathered skin, dark weathered duster and practical leather layers
C_sun_kael.performance: Stillness is active. He solves the immediate human problem, treats strange coincidence as misfortune, luck or other people's business, and rarely chases explanations. Do not play him as frightened by the mystery or as if he is concealing secret guilt.
C_sun_kael.relationship: Eva follows because she senses adventure; Jessa starts saying 'we' before Kael accepts that there is a we; Veyra pursues him as though a hidden human explanation must exist; the Preacher helps create situations around him. Kael resists being turned into anyone else's story.
promptContinuity: not a hunted-fugitive performance unless a specific local story misreads him that way

C_sun_eva.name: Eva O'Leary
C_sun_eva.role: sixteen-year-old adventurer and pattern-chaser who senses that Kael's bad luck is too well composed to ignore
C_sun_eva.voice: quick, direct, curious, willing to say the uncomfortable thing
C_sun_eva.visual: small wiry teenage girl, heart-shaped face, dark hazel eyes, chin-length dark-brown hair, weathered charcoal hood, layered practical wraps and oversized desert clothing
C_sun_eva.performance: Curiosity pulls her into risk. She tests theories, pushes people, makes wrong deductions, notices patterns and learns from consequences. Do not use her as an exposition mouthpiece; her questions should come from appetite, suspicion, excitement or concern in the immediate scene.
C_sun_eva.relationship: Kael looks like an adventure she can keep walking into. She likes Jessa's competence and increasingly treats the three of them as a real group before Kael does. Veyra's pursuit turns Eva's curiosity into a contest over who understands the pattern first.
promptContinuity: adventure-seeking energy rather than solemn detective posture

C_sun_jessa.name: Jessa Petrescu
C_sun_jessa.role: practical pilot who recognizes when a place is getting too hot and keeps pushing movement until the temporary arrangement becomes a group
C_sun_jessa.voice: clipped, utilitarian, action-first; dry rather than emotionless
C_sun_jessa.visual: lean athletic woman, olive sun-weathered skin, jet-black hair in a messy high bun, brass-rimmed goggles, high-collared pale shirt, layered leather utility belts
C_sun_jessa.performance: Helps mid-action, keeps working while other people talk, and calls for the exit before everyone else agrees they need one. Her curiosity keeps undercutting her claim that she only wants to move on.
C_sun_jessa.relationship: She tells Kael 'we're leaving' before he thinks there is a we; he initially wonders whether she has mistaken him too, but she has not. She stays because she likes Kael and Eva, is curious where this goes, and has her own ordinary reason not to remain where she began.
promptContinuity: no mystical knowledge or secret-mastermind posture

C_sun_ray.name: Ray Silvestro
C_sun_ray.role: Cadre gunslinger who expects structure and fails when the situation refuses to resolve cleanly
C_sun_ray.voice: precise, controlled, economical until uncertainty breaks the rhythm
C_sun_ray.visual: tall lean man, angular face, chestnut wind-swept hair, ornate weathered brown long coat, dark vest, red neckcloth, refined sidearm
C_sun_ray.performance: Measures distance and angle, composes himself before acting, becomes visibly less certain when the environment changes.

C_sun_lagartos.name: Los Lagartos
C_sun_lagartos.role: Cadre presence that makes a place hard to leave
C_sun_lagartos.voice: slow, spare, collective when speaking for the group
C_sun_lagartos.visual: a small hard-traveled frontier cadre in dust-dark layered coats and route-worn gear; visually cohesive without supernatural anatomy
C_sun_lagartos.performance: Occupy exits and paths rather than rushing people. Their pressure comes from refusing to move.

C_sun_isabelle.name: Isabelle Torres
C_sun_isabelle.role: Cadre singer who turns attention and intimacy into pressure
C_sun_isabelle.visual: elegant frontier performer in dark layered stagewear with worn metallic detail, practical boots and carefully controlled posture
C_sun_isabelle.performance: Closes distance calmly, watches the response, and makes a room feel smaller without raising her voice.

C_sun_preacher.name: Samuel Hayes
C_sun_preacher.role: Veyra's advance social engineer, traveling ahead to seed expectations around Kael; over time the manipulation resolves into genuine congregational care
C_sun_preacher.voice: warm, associative, disarming; capable of steering a conversation without sounding like a pitch
C_sun_preacher.visual: weathered middle-aged man in sun-faded layered clothes, worn coat, scarf and practical route gear
C_sun_preacher.performance: Listens first, earns trust, plants one idea in the right ear, and keeps talking while working. The people he was meant to manipulate become real congregants to him, creating moral friction. Avoid theatrical sermon poses.
C_sun_preacher.relationship: Works for Veyra and precedes Kael's group to shape what communities expect. He is complicit in the manipulation but increasingly cares about the people affected by it and eventually has reason to stop going ahead and come along.
promptContinuity: social manipulation is human rather than magical
moral ambiguity precedes genuine pastoral care

C_sun_sandrider.name: Sand Rider
C_sun_sandrider.role: Cadre tracker who remains at the edge of events
C_sun_sandrider.voice: brief observations about terrain, weather, pressure and route conditions
C_sun_sandrider.visual: lean weathered rider in layered canvas, wrapped face protection, sun goggles and wind-worn travel gear
C_sun_sandrider.performance: Stays near edges and horizons, reads conditions before people, rarely crowds the frame.

C_sun_brute.name: Marcus Kovacs
C_sun_brute.role: local muscle who mistakes physical control for authority
C_sun_brute.visual: large heavy-built man in work-worn frontier clothes with improvised protective gear
C_sun_brute.performance: Uses his size and proximity first; reaches for tools and pipes before elaborate weapons.

C_sun_veyra.name: Veyra Linger
C_sun_veyra.role: pursuer and investigator following Kael's contradictory story; initially believes he is hiding a human past and uses the Preacher to pressure that truth into the open
C_sun_veyra.voice: controlled, exact, skeptical; concrete even when the evidence stops cooperating
C_sun_veyra.visual: weathered woman in fitted tracking leathers, polished field boots, brass optics, map case and measuring tools
C_sun_veyra.performance: Arrives after events, reconstructs what happened, and tests Kael through social setups rather than open confrontation. She notices the accumulating improbability earlier than the others but digs further into her role instead of announcing a theory. Her confidence thins before her pursuit stops.
C_sun_veyra.relationship: Directs the Preacher's advance manipulation and follows Kael rather than traveling with him at first. She treats Eva and Jessa as witnesses and possible contamination of the pattern. Eventually her own interference stops explaining the outcomes, which frightens her without making her mystical or omniscient.

C_sun_forger.name: Dylan Stator
C_sun_forger.role: traveling companion who reads unstable structures and routes
C_sun_forger.visual: weathered traveler in layered work clothes with chalk, compass, hand tools and a dust-dark coat
C_sun_forger.performance: Reads surfaces with hands and tools, changes direction when the material evidence changes.

C_sun_hanging_man.name: Hanging man
C_sun_hanging_man.role: unnamed local execution victim Kael cuts down behind the Last Drop
C_sun_hanging_man.visual: dusty local man in ordinary work clothes, rope-burned neck, exhausted and barely able to stand
C_sun_hanging_man.performance: Panicked while hanging; coughing, disoriented and physically dependent after the rope is cut.
